Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Trendy Threads Boutique, we specialize in providing a diverse range of fashionable clothing and accessories for men, women, and children, catering to both retail and wholesale customers. Our operations include sourcing high-quality apparel from renowned manufacturers and ensuring a seamless shopping experience through our physical storefront and online platform. We prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to stay ahead of fashion trends by frequently updating our inventory. Additionally, our store includes a small in-house alteration section, which constitutes less than 10% of our overall business activities. Security is a mainstay of our operations, as we have implemented a robust central monitored alarm system to protect our inventory valued at over $500,000. We do not engage in the sale of private-label or relabeled goods, ensuring our merchandise remains compliant with industry standards.

Underwriting Guidelines:
Industry-Specific Restrictions
To mitigate underwriting risks specific to clothing and apparel
businesses, the following restrictions apply:
• Alarm System Requirement: For inventory valued over $500,000, a central monitored
alarm system is mandatory. This reduces the likelihood and severity of theft losses and aligns
with insurer risk controls.
• Repair Operations Limitation: Repair or alteration activities must be incidental, defined
as less than 10% of total business operations by revenue or time. This restriction prevents
underwriting risks associated with specialty trade contractors, which require different coverage
forms.
• Prohibition on Private-Label or Relabeled Goods: Businesses primarily dealing in
private-label or relabeled apparel are excluded due to increased product liability and regula-
tory compliance risks.
